name: Xenion Communications
summary: Perth ISP and network-design company: virtual hosting, VPS, colocation, caching and transit (XENION PTY LTD AS TRUSTEE FOR THE CHADD FAMILY TRUST, ACN 128 843 729); WAIX-connected; defunct by the mid-2010s.

events.details: First captured Jan 2007; news archive from Jun 2008.
ISP/hosting site last confirmed Feb 2016. Xenion hosting page last live Aug 2011 and the domain redirects away by Oct 2016 with unrelated reuse in 2017 - 'by 2016' verified.

refs.label: Genuine Xenion hosting page with news to Jun 2011 (last live capture Aug 2011).
